hints.title: Pairs should disappear
hints.body: You need an operation that cancels two equal values but preserves the one value that has no partner. Which arithmetic or logical operation has that property?

hints.title: Bitwise XOR
hints.body: For integers, `a XOR a = 0` and `a XOR 0 = a`. XOR is also associative and commutative, so the order of the signals does not matter.

hints.title: Fold the list
hints.body: Start with zero and XOR every signal into one running value. Every pair contributes zero, so the final result is exactly the value that appears once.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = 0
for value in signals:
    result = result XOR value
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. In TypeScript, use `^=` for the XOR update.
